calleeScope.711220: Writes4 bytes through RDX, forwards only its own local to63e220; never publishes caller output pointer.
calleeScope.63e220: Writes exactly4 through RDX; compression descriptor read-only. Diagnostic calls receive scalar decoded values/static format strings, not output pointer.
calleeScope.746070: Writes exactly4 through RDX; diagnostic calls receive scalars/static strings. Does not publish output pointer.
calleeScope.6ead40: R8 output offsets0/4/8 only; R9 input12 bytes read-only.746070 receives only callee-local outputs and descriptor.
calleeScope.698600/2692d0: Read-only comparison;698600 forwards offsets54/64 to2692d0, which reads three floats and has no calls/stores.
calleeScope.6491f0/6ec2d0/6ec7d0: This caller passes original external vector/record objects, no address of the private frame or homes. Their general heap mutation is not certified by this spill proof.
calleeScope.698570: Call6f2cfe receives RCX=RDI+10 from6f2c4a. Exact leaf writes only this external 0x90-byte record region; RSP70 is the previously copied read-only comparison snapshot passed separately to698600.

assumptions: Ordinary well-formed native callers: preexisting packet/vector allocations do not alias this newly allocated private frame. No arbitrary corruption, external memory writes or asynchronous stack inspection certified.
limitations: Only the two exact reloads are proved. Later RSP30 reuse is real and is not restored. No new receiver ABI, full-function Mission register invariant, segmented hook approval or thread-quiescence proof.
This proof assumes well-formed incoming packet/vector/descriptor objects and valid native record indices. It does not certify record bounds or allocator behavior under corrupt packet state.

supersedes.reason: 698570 at6f2cfe writes external RDI+10, not local RSP70. Old effect annotation must not authorize a new hook.

entryPreconditions.rdx: existing vector header with valid external record backing

argumentFlow.method: Independent all-predecessor pointer-only fixed point, register clobbers on calls, partial-register kills, exact saved input homes, exact 0xe0 record stride, all consumed pointer arguments asserted.

externalRecordNonAliasProof.inputHeader: Incoming RDX is saved at entryRSP+0x10 by6f277b and reloaded via RBP+0xe8 at6f2849/6f289d/6f2977. RBP is entryRSP-0xd8.
externalRecordNonAliasProof.backingField: 6f285a or post-resize6f28ae loads field0 of this input vector header into R8.6491f0 may replace that backing allocation; the reloaded pointer remains external to this private frame.
externalRecordNonAliasProof.recordAddress: 6f28b1 sign-extends logical index,6f28b4 multiplies by0xe0,6f28bb adds backing to RDI. This is a record address only under the explicit valid-index/preexisting-allocation precondition.
externalRecordNonAliasProof.resetArgument: 6f2c4a forms RCX=RDI+0x10; independent all-predecessor flow proves that value reaches6f2cfe. No subsequent RCX write changes the argument.
externalRecordNonAliasProof.snapshot: 6f2c52..6f2cfa copy selected original-record fields into local RSP70..ff. This snapshot is passed read-only in RCX at6f2d21; RDX there points to original record+10.
externalRecordNonAliasProof.conclusion: Under well-formed caller object/index preconditions, original-record resets and decoder outputs cannot alias current private Mission home RSP30. This is not unconditional validation of arbitrary input pointers or indices.
